mintAuthority.summary: SLVon is a centrally issued Ondo Global Markets tokenized ETF tracker with independent issuer-native GM mint paths on Ethereum, BSC, and Solana. Ethereum and BSC use upgradeable token deployments administered through 2-hour timelocks; their native GMTokenManager paths remain in Mint Authority. Ethereum and BSC also grant separate OndoOFT bridge-minter roles, while HyperEVM is representation-only; those OFT and representation controls are scoped under risk-review.bridgeRouteRisk. The Solana Token-2022 mint authority is Ondo's GM program PDA, while a single EOA can upgrade that program without an on-chain delay.

upgradeability.controlRef: SLVon Ethereum and BSC beacon-owner timelocks

controls.label: Ondo Global Markets issuance backend
controls.evidence: Ondo GM mints/redeems SLVon against custodied SLV economic exposure for eligible investors only; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists and eligibility/transfer restrictions are enforced by the issuer.

controls.label: GMTokenManager (MINTER_ROLE[0])
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770488, MINTER_ROLE on SLVon ETH included 0x2c158bc456e027b2affccadf1bdbd9f5fc4c5c8c. Ondo's official addresses identify it as the Ethereum GMTokenManager used for Global Markets issuance, distinct from the Ethereum OndoOFT bridge minter.

controls.label: SLVon Ethereum admin and beacon-owner TimelockController (2-hour delay)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531363, getMinDelay() returned 7200. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE had two members: the timelock itself and 5-of-9 Safe 0xcd35671dcab88d05ee29dc4d360181529390b17f. PROPOSER_ROLE had 0x71a4d411b5f7941dee020417fca30413712f1646. EXECUTOR_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE each had 0x2e55b738f5969eea10fb67e326bee5e2fa15a2cc and 0xff1621ee754512b34a6bd62a941cc4d5e4d0b85b. The same timelock owns the Ethereum beacon and remains the token DEFAULT_ADMIN, so it can replace mint logic or authorize minters after the 2-hour delay.

controls.label: Ondo governance Safe - Ethereum TimelockController admin (5-of-9)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531363, this Safe remained one of the TimelockController's two DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE members. getOwners() returned the same nine owners, getThreshold() returned 5, getModulesPaginated returned no modules, the guard slot was zero, VERSION() returned 1.4.1, and slot 0 resolved singleton 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a.

controls.label: SLVon Ethereum and BSC beacon-owner timelocks
controls.evidence: This native-only control exists because the upgradeability schema accepts one controlRef; it does not imply a shared controller. Ethereum beacon 0x985462c9... is owned by timelock 0x3715b215..., and BSC beacon 0xc046b05a... is owned by timelock 0x8860bbfc.... Each native owner returned getMinDelay() = 7200. The Ethereum timelock is administered by 5-of-9 Safe 0xcd35671d.... At pinned BSC block 111360010, the BSC timelock had itself plus 5-of-9 Safe 0xa3a3c713... in DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; proposer, executor, and canceller memberships were also enumerated. HyperEVM representation upgrade administration is relocated to Bridge Risk.

controls.label: SLVon BSC GMTokenManager (MINTER_ROLE[0])
controls.evidence: At BSC block 116349076, SLVon MINTER_ROLE included Ondo's documented BSC GMTokenManager 0x91f8aff3738825e8eb16fc6f6b1a7a4647bdb299 and a separate OndoOFT 0x02a4144f5f84fcfbca63f89f1c0038d3053ea525. This control retains only the issuer-native GMTokenManager; the OFT bridge minter and its route facts are authored under risk-review.bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.label: Ondo governance Safe - BSC TimelockController admin (5-of-9)
controls.evidence: At pinned BSC block 111360781 (hash 0xfb98ca2bf4c080005fd985a803004c3cbba40d6ca976b3715b7eeef8e3b7f0c7), this Safe returned the listed nine owners and threshold 5. getModulesPaginated returned no modules, the guard slot was zero, VERSION() returned 1.4.1, and slot 0 resolved singleton 0x29fcb43b.... It is a DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member of the SLVon BSC timelock.

controls.label: Ondo Solana GM program mint-authority PDA
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 439724580 on 2026-08-16, the SLVon Token-2022 mint authority was 9foMHsSDq7nMg4WPusSz9eY7tyxyukqborA8GyU5cUxD, consistent with Ondo's GM program-derived mint-authority PDA. Ondo's GM API supports the native solana-900 mint path, and Zellic's audit identifies the program's mint-authority PDA and minting instruction controls.

controls.label: Ondo Solana GM program upgrade authority
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 439724580 on 2026-08-16, Ondo's GM program ProgramData account F4F1ZdqwmT4KfCfCnXrqLp9R6Liq4vEqJcs64xVKTKeU named 9ECeczLtFZDYE3NX6G7uNw5BUGjoJAu1kFyEihA5hMaM as upgrade authority. That funded, zero-data system account can replace native minting logic without an on-chain timelock.

review.evidence: Sourcify verifies the Ethereum token and native Ethereum beacon, and pinned RPC reads resolve the Ethereum and BSC beacons, implementations, and 2-hour owner timelocks. Ethereum and BSC each have a documented native GMTokenManager path; their separate OndoOFT bridge minters are excluded from Mint Authority and reviewed under risk-review.bridgeRouteRisk. At finalized Solana slot 439724580, the SLVon Token-2022 mint named Ondo's audited GM-program PDA as native mint authority, while the upgradeable program named a single funded system-account EOA as its no-delay upgrade authority. HyperEVM representation upgrade administration is also excluded from Mint Authority. These observations close the native authority questions; centralized upgrade and mint paths remain scoring risks rather than evidence gaps. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer-controlled direct minting plus a no-delay Solana upgrade EOA is economically unbounded, Ankura reconciles product liabilities to reserves daily, and independent attestation exists without a named prudential product supervisor.
